units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 30:3">Targ. Prov. XXX, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 12:16">Targ. Jer. XII, 16</cite> <he>מֵילַף יֵלְפוּן</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 11:25">Targ. Prov. XI, 25</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:13">Ab. I, 13</cite> <he>ודלא יָלֵיף</he> he who does not study (the Law).
Yeb. 57ᵃ, a. fr. יַלְפִינָן we derive; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. יְלִיף, f. יְלִיפָא accustomed, used to.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:4:3">Y. Sot. I, 16ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>הוה י׳ דריש וכ׳</he> used to preach &c.

<cite ref="Yoma 2a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>והוה … יְלִיפָה שמעה קליה</he> and there was there a certain woman who made it a habit to listen to him; (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> <cite ref="J00529"><he>יציבא</he></cite>, corr. acc.); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bava Metzia 100b:1">B. Mets. 100ᵇ</cite>, <he>בדיילפי</he>, v. <cite ref="L00303"><he>לוּף</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 15:3">Targ. Job XV, 3</cite>; a. e.—Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ top <he>מֵילֵיף ומְיַלְּפָה</he> to learn (from you) and to teach (you).

senses.gloss: <cite ref="J00387">same</cite>, v. <cite ref="A01933"><he>אֲלַף</he></cite>.—Y. Shebi. V, end, 36ᵃ <he>ולא כן אוֹלְפָן רבי</he> did you not teach us thus?; Y. Dem. I, 22ᵃ top <he>אילפן</he> (corr. acc.).
